description.tr: Sistematik karşılaştırmalı felsefe yoluyla İslam tasavvufu ile Hindu Vedanta düşüncesini köprüledi || Dârâ Şükûh, Upanişadları Kur'an'da atıfta bulunulan 'Gizli Kitap' olarak gördü. || [Tarih notu] Evrengzib tarafından idamı, onu yarıda kalan dinlerarası diyaloğun sembolü yaptı.
description.en: Bridged Islamic Sufi and Hindu Vedantic thought through systematic comparative philosophy; his Upanishad translations became the channel through which Indian philosophy reached Schopenhauer and European Romanticism || Dara Shikoh saw the Upanishads as the 'Hidden Book' referenced in the Quran. His work represents the most sophisticated Muslim engagement with Hindu philosophy in Mughal India. || [Historiographical note] His execution by Aurangzeb made him a symbol of interfaith dialogue cut short. His Upanishad translations influenced European orientalism through Anquetil-Duperron (1801).
description.ar: ربط بين التصوف الإسلامي والفيدانتا الهندية عبر فلسفة مقارنة منهجية || رأى دارا شكوه في الأوبانيشاد 'الكتاب المكنون' المذكور في القرآن
